features.notes: Verifies the 88 white and 36 black key model with A-to-C range and hammer action.
Six ordered hardware sections with normalized width fractions: Performance 13%, Organ 21%, Piano 15%, Program 9%, Synth 21%, Effects 21%.
Controls have stable IDs and are section-specific. Only Program and Synth have primary OLED displays. Organ, Piano, Effects do not.
Keys respond to pointer input with pressed/released visual state.
Buttons toggle with visual feedback. LEDs display on/off state.
Knobs and encoders respond to pointer drag with smooth rotation. Values are clamped to range.
All interactive controls have accessible names, roles (slider, button, status), and focus states.
Continuous red chassis with top rail, end cheeks, and bottom lip. No white gaps or detached pieces. No marketing region above instrument.
